          wget https://go.dev/dl/go1.20.4.linux-amd64.tar.gz
          rm -rf /usr/local/go && tar -C /usr/local -xzf go1.20.4.linux-amd64.tar.gz
          export PATH=$PATH:/usr/local/go/bin
          go version

          # set +x here to hide pass from log
          set +xe

          echo "podman login with serviceaccount"

          # Used for 4.16 and newer releases.
          pass=$( jq .\"image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000\".auth /var/run/secrets/openshift.io/push/.dockercfg )
          pass=`echo ${pass:1:-1} | base64 -d`
          podman login -u serviceaccount -p ${pass:8} image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000 --tls-verify=false

          # Used for 4.15 and older releases.
          if ! podman login --get-login image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000 &> /dev/null; then
            pass=$( jq .\"image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000\".password /var/run/secrets/openshift.io/push/.dockercfg )
            podman login -u serviceaccount -p ${pass:1:-1} image-registry.openshift-image-registry.svc:5000 --tls-verify=false
          fi

          set -x

          export IMG=PTP_IMAGE
          export DAEMON_IMG="DAEMON_IMAGE"
          export SIDECAR_IMG="SIDECAR_IMAGE"

          export T5CI_VERSION="T5CI_VERSION_VAL"
          export USE_UPSTREAM="USE_UPSTREAM_VAL"

          # run latest release on upstream main branch
          if [[ "${USE_UPSTREAM:-false}" == "true" ]]; then
            echo "Running on upstream main branch"
            git clone --single-branch --branch main https://github.com/k8snetworkplumbingwg/ptp-operator.git
          else
            git clone --single-branch --branch OPERATOR_VERSION https://github.com/openshift/ptp-operator.git
          fi
          cd ptp-operator
          # OCPBUGS-52327 fix build due to libresolv.so link error
          sed -i "s/\(CGO_ENABLED=\${CGO_ENABLED}\) \(GOOS=\${GOOS}\)/\1 CC=\"gcc -fuse-ld=gold\" \2/" hack/build.sh
          # For UPSTREAM use Dockerfile for upstream contents
          if [[ "$T5CI_VERSION" =~ 4.1[2-8]+ || "${USE_UPSTREAM:-false}" == "true" ]]; then
            sed -i "/ENV GO111MODULE=off/ a\ENV GOMAXPROCS=20" Dockerfile
            make docker-build
          else
            # Dockerfile is updated to upstream in 4.19+. Use .ocp or .ci versions for non-UPSTREAM runs
            if [ -f "Dockerfile.ocp" ]; then
              DOCKERFILE="Dockerfile.ocp"
            else
              DOCKERFILE="Dockerfile.ci"
            fi
            sed -i "/ENV GO111MODULE=off/ a\ENV GOMAXPROCS=20" "$DOCKERFILE"
            podman build -t "${IMG}" -f "$DOCKERFILE"
          fi
          podman push ${IMG} --tls-verify=false
          cd ..

          if [[ "${USE_UPSTREAM:-false}" == "false" ]]; then
            # If we a running a downstream run we are done
            exit 0
          fi

          # If were running upstream we should also use the upstream daemon!
          echo "Running on upstream main branch of linuxptp-daemon"
          git clone --single-branch --branch main https://github.com/k8snetworkplumbingwg/linuxptp-daemon.git
          cd linuxptp-daemon
          # Split DAEMON_IMG into IMAGE_TAG_BASE and VERSION because
          # hack/build-image.sh unconditionally overwrites IMG from these two vars.
          IMAGE_TAG_BASE="${DAEMON_IMG%:*}" VERSION="${DAEMON_IMG##*:}" make image
          podman push ${DAEMON_IMG} --tls-verify=false
          cd ..

          echo "Running on main branch of cloud-event-proxy"
          git clone --single-branch --branch main https://github.com/redhat-cne/cloud-event-proxy.git
          cd cloud-event-proxy
          IMG=${SIDECAR_IMG} make podman-build
          podman push ${SIDECAR_IMG} --tls-verify=false
          cd ..

      securityContext:
        privileged: true
      volumeMounts:
        - mountPath: /var/run/secrets/openshift.io/push
          name: dockercfg
          readOnly: true
        - name: secret-volume
          mountPath: /root/.docker

        items:
        - key: .dockerconfigjson
          path: config.json

    - name: dockercfg
      secret:
        secretName: BUILDER_DOCKERCFG
        defaultMode: 384

---

**TL;DR:** ts2phc/BC PTP lock never achieved and a pmc command regression together collapsed all 36 sync tests.

**Overall Issue Class:** test_regression
**Overall Severity:** HIGH

## Root Causes (36 failures across 4 suites)

### ~15/36 failures — BC slave port never locked (FREERUN, clockClass=248)
- **Suites:** dualnicbc (6), dualnicbcha (9) | **Evidence:** PROVEN
- **What:** BC's ens2f0np0 stayed in MASTER role throughout both suites; clockClass=248 confirmed. Hypothesis (unverified cascade from tgm): cnfdf32 T-GM in FREERUN may have deprived the BC of an upstream grandmaster, but no direct clock-identity linkage exists across suites.
- **Breaking change:** Unknown (possible lab T-GM GNSS failure or release-5.0 ptp4l announce regression)
- **Flake?** No | **Fix:** Confirm cnfdf32 GNSS signal health; if healthy, audit release-5.0 ptp4l announce-message handling.

### ~3/36 failures — pmc GET PARENT_DATA_SET split into two rejected commands
- **Suites:** dualnicbc (3 explicit), dualnicbcha (subset) | **Evidence:** PROVEN
- **What:** `pmc` receives "GET" and "PARENT_DATA_SET" as separate commands, both rejected as "bad command"; identical on two different socket paths (`ptp4l.1.config`, `ptp4l.0.config`), ruling out config-specificity. See `linuxptp-daemon/pkg/pmc/pmc.go:40–58`.
- **Breaking change:** Candidate (unverified): linuxptp-daemon [PR #629](https://github.com/k8snetworkplumbingwg/linuxptp-daemon/pull/629) sha `14eb788` (upstream sync 2026-07-22)
- **Flake?** No | **Fix:** Fix `RunPMCExp`/goexpect to transmit `"GET PARENT_DATA_SET"` as a single input line.

### 11/36 failures — T-GM ts2phc FREERUN despite DPLL LOCKED (cnfdf32)
- **Suites:** tgm | **Evidence:** PROVEN
- **What:** DPLL=LOCKED (state=1) but ts2phc=FREERUN (state=0) on ens7fx/cnfdf32; ptp4l never reaches clockClass=6; all WPC GM, holdover, event, and recovery tests time out waiting for lock.
- **Breaking change:** Unknown (release-5.0 branch not locally cloned; backport unverifiable)
- **Flake?** No | **Fix:** Inspect ts2phc config for ens7fx on cnfdf32 in the release-5.0 image; verify DPLL→ts2phc IPC path.

### 4/36 failures — TBC no WPC hardware solution + event consumer never ready
- **Suites:** bc+dualfollower+tbc+all | **Evidence:** PROVEN
- **What:** (2 tests) TBC topology solver returns 0 solutions — lab lacks a WPC NIC node with ≥3 ports; BeforeSuite fails hard instead of skipping (`testconfig.go:1898–1899`). (2 tests) bc/dualfollower parallel event tests failed (`PtpEventsIsConsumerReady=false`); their serial counterparts passed — event infra failure independent of PTP sync.
- **Breaking change:** TBC: Candidate (unverified) [PR #205](https://github.com/openshift/ptp-operator/pull/205) `aede1e9`. Event consumer: Unknown.
- **Flake?** No | **Fix:** Add graceful skip in `PtpConfigTelcoBC()` when solver returns 0 solutions; separately fix event-consumer pod startup in ptp-event-framework-test.

## Action Items
1. **linuxptp-daemon team:** Fix `RunPMCExp`/goexpect to send `"GET PARENT_DATA_SET"` as one command; verify whether PR #629 (sha `14eb788`) was backported to release-5.0 and introduced the split.
2. **Lab/ptp-operator team:** Debug ts2phc FREERUN on cnfdf32 — DPLL is LOCKED but ts2phc is not tracking ens7fx; confirm GNSS signal health and inspect release-5.0 ts2phc config/IPC path for this hardware.
3. **Test team:** Add a graceful suite-level skip in `PtpConfigTelcoBC()` when the solver returns 0 solutions; separately investigate event-consumer pod readiness in the ptp-event-framework-test namespace.

## Open Questions
1. **Classification contradiction (dualnicbc vs dualnicbcha):** dualnicbc is classified `test_failure` while dualnicbcha is `infra_other` for near-identical symptoms (BC FREERUN + pmc bad command). Per-suite classifications are retained without override; the ambiguity between a daemon regression and a lab GNSS failure is unresolved.
2. **Unverified T-GM→BC cascade:** T-GM FREERUN on cnfdf32 (tgm suite) may explain BC FREERUN in dualnicbc/dualnicbcha, but no cross-suite clock-identity linkage exists in the evidence; marked as HYPOTHESIS.
3. **Serial-passed/parallel-failed paradox (bc+dualfollower):** bc and dualfollower serial suites passed (PTP sync healthy); parallel event tests failed because the event-consumer pod was never ready — a separate infra issue, not a global sync failure.

---

**TL;DR:** TBC parallel suite `SynchronizedBeforeSuite` failed because the lab has no external PTP GM sending frames, so the graph solver cannot construct a T-BC topology.

**Overall Issue Class:** infra_other
**Overall Severity:** MEDIUM

## Root Cause Groups

### Group A — TBC topology unsolvable: no external PTP GM in lab (31 tests)
- **Tests:** `[SynchronizedBeforeSuite]` × 31 parallel Ginkgo workers (all TBC parallel tests), all TBC serial `[tbc-serial] PTP e2e tests` subtests skipped with `no T-BC solution found for TBC`
- **Classification:** infra_issue | **Confidence:** high
- **Evidence:**
  - `graphsolver.go:73] Solution for TBC problem does not exists`
  - `l2lib.go:448] interfaces receiving PTP frames: []` (seen on all 3 nodes at 16:31:55 UTC)
  - `[FAILED] SynchronizedBeforeSuite failed on Ginkgo parallel process #1` → `parallel_suite_test.go:43`: `Expect(err).To(BeNil(), "Could not create a ptp config")` — propagated to all 31 workers
- **Root Cause:** The L2-discovery scan found zero interfaces receiving PTP frames on nodes cnfdf30/31/32. The graph solver requires at least one interface with an active external upstream GM to solve the TBC problem (a T-BC needs a slave port fed by an external source). Without any PTP traffic, `CreatePtpConfigurationsWithRetry(3)` exhausts all retries and fails, aborting every parallel Ginkgo process. The test scripts run from `main` branch (which recently added TBC CI tests via [PR #205](https://github.com/openshift/ptp-operator/pull/205), commit `aede1e9`) against `release-4.22` product images, but the lab at telco5gran.eng.rdu2.redhat.com has no external GM cabled in.
- **Breaking PR/Commit:** Candidate (unverified): `aede1e9 Merge pull request #205 from nocturnalastro/tbc_ci_tests` on `main` — added TBC as a required CI test mode before verifying the target lab has the necessary topology. Only on `main`; not cherry-picked to `release-4.22`.
- **Flake?** No — reproducible until external GM is connected or TBC mode is made optional for this lab.
- **Fix:** Either (a) provision an external upstream GM in the telco5gran lab and cable it to one interface on a worker node, or (b) guard the TBC parallel `SynchronizedBeforeSuite` so it calls `Skip()` (like the serial `BeforeEach` already does) rather than `Fail()` when no TBC topology is discoverable.

## Summary Table

| # | Test | Group | Classification | Confidence | Root Cause (one line) | Fix |
|---|------|-------|---------------|------------|----------------------|-----|
| 1 | `[SynchronizedBeforeSuite]` (×31 parallel workers) | A | infra_issue | high | No external GM → graph solver finds no TBC solution → `CreatePtpConfigurationsWithRetry` fails | Add external GM to lab or make parallel BeforeSuite skip instead of fail |
| 2 | All `[tbc-serial] PTP e2e tests` subtests | A | infra_issue | high | Same root cause; serial suite gracefully skips but records failure exit | Same fix |

## Action Items
1. **Lab infrastructure**: Cable an external PTP GM source to at least one interface on a cnfdf3x worker node so the L2 scanner detects PTP frames and the graph solver can construct a TBC topology.
2. **Test resilience**: In `parallel_suite_test.go:43`, change `CreatePtpConfigurationsWithRetry` failure handling to `Skip(...)` (not `Fail(...)`) when the error is specifically "no T-BC solution found", mirroring the graceful skip already in the serial suite's `BeforeEach` at `ptp.go:370` — this prevents a missing lab topology from blocking CI permanently.
